findings.text: follow-on: isolation rests on the credential being absent rather than on the HTTP call being blocked, so a test that sets OPENROUTER_API_KEY_RECKON and dispatches with the default caller would still reach the live service; a urlopen-level autouse stub would harden the guard.
follow-on: the after_suite arm ran at a530745b while the reviewed head is fa06460a (a docs-only commit), so the gate log names a revision one commit below the tree head; behaviour is unaffected.
